description: This PHP source file defines classes and methods for a parser used in Smarty template engine's configuration file processing. It includes a stack entry class, a parser class with parsing logic, token handling, and error management.

classes.name: TPC_yyStackEntry
classes.description: Represents a stack entry in the parser's stack, holding state number and token values.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Configfileparser
classes.description: Parser class generated from a yacc-like grammar, responsible for parsing Smarty config files, managing parser state, tokens, and errors.

methods.name: yy_destructor
methods.description: Handles cleanup for tokens during parsing, default does nothing.

methods.name: yy_parse_failed
methods.description: Handles parser failure, cleans up stack.

methods.name: yy_syntax_error
methods.description: Handles syntax errors, triggers config file error.

methods.name: yy_accept
methods.description: Handles successful parse acceptance, cleans up stack.

methods.name: doParse
methods.description: Main parsing function, processes tokens and manages parser state machine.

methods.name: parse_bool
methods.description: Parses string tokens into boolean values based on common true indicators.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable in the target array, handling overwrite and array merging.

methods.name: add_global_vars
methods.description: Adds variables to global config data.

methods.name: add_section_vars
methods.description: Adds variables to a specific section in config data.
